vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Look! The rain stopped, and there is a rainbow! How does a rainbow get there?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: I know! A giant painter in the sky, with a huge paintbrush! Swish, swish!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Ha ha! Good guess, Leo! But a rainbow is made by two things: sunlight, and raindrops!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Sunlight and raindrops? How?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Let's ask a raindrop! Here comes our old friend, Drippy!

vo.speaker: drippy
vo.text: Hi again! I'm Drippy! Today, I'm going to help make a rainbow!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Question one. What is sunlight made of?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Sunlight looks white. But it is really all the colors of the rainbow, mixed together!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Look! When light goes through this glass shape, the colors spread out!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's say the colors! Ready?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Red!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Orange!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Yellow!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Green!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Blue!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Indigo!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Violet!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Seven colors! Show me seven fingers! Five, and two more!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Let's find rainbow colors all around us!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Red, like an apple!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Orange, like an orange!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Yellow, like a banana!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Green, like a leaf!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Blue, like the sky!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Indigo, like the night sky!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: And violet, like a little flower!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Question two. How does a raindrop make a rainbow?

vo.speaker: drippy
vo.text: The sunlight shines into me...

vo.speaker: drippy
vo.text: Inside me, the light bends, and bounces, and the colors spread out! Ta-da!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Millions of raindrops do this all together, and we see one big, bright rainbow!

vo.speaker: drippy
vo.text: Teamwork! We're a rainbow team!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Question three. Where do we look to find a rainbow?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Stand with the sun behind you, and the rain in front of you. Then look up!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Game time! Where should the sun be? In front of you, or behind you?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Behind me! And the rain in front!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Wow fact! A rainbow is really a whole circle! From an airplane, you can sometimes see the full circle!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: A rainbow circle? Like a giant rainbow donut! Yum!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: And sometimes you can see two rainbows! A double rainbow! In the second one, the colors are upside down!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Two rainbows? Double the fun!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Hmm... can we see a rainbow at night, when there is no sun?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: No! A rainbow needs sunlight. No sun, no rainbow!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Let's make our own rainbow! Ask a grown-up to help.

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Step one. Fill a clear glass with water.

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Step two. Put the glass in a sunny window.

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Step three. Hold a white paper on the floor, below the glass... and look!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Ta-da! A little rainbow on the paper!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Color game! What color comes after yellow?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Green!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: What color is at the top of the rainbow?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Red! Red is always on top!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Let's remember!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What two things make a rainbow?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Sunlight and raindrops!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: How many colors are in the rainbow?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Seven!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Where is the sun when you see a rainbow?

vo.speaker: drippy
vo.text: Behind you!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What color is on top?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Red!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What shape is a rainbow, really?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: A circle!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Let's say it together!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Sun behind!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Rain in front!

vo.speaker: drippy
vo.text: Seven colors!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Rainbow bright!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Your turn! Sun behind! Rain in front! Seven colors! Rainbow bright!

vo.speaker: drippy
vo.text: Thanks for making a rainbow with me! Bye-bye!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: See you next time, friends!
